architecture_identity: VIA owns interaction-facing grounding, agent-neutral initial delegation, and user-facing lifecycle; a selected downstream Agent owns domain reasoning and execution.
via_owns: interaction-facing input handling without committed logical UserTurn authority
invariants: VIA is not a general-purpose Agent runtime.
DP-00 does not select committed logical UserTurn authority; that authority remains unresolved until DP-01.
The candidate does not prescribe exactly two model calls or any other call count.
All state-changing domain work crosses into the selected Agent boundary.
